tokenize_burmese_texts: tokenize a list of Burmese text strings into segmented word lists using the CRF tagger
segment_burmese_word: segment a Burmese sentence into space-separated words using the trained CRF model
create_char_features_for_position: create character-level feature vectors for a given position in a Burmese sentence
create_word_features_for_sentence: create a list of character feature vectors for every position in a Burmese sentence
review_tokenize_function: review the tokenize function that segments Burmese text using a CRF-based word segmentation model
